blocks.text: IBA, Zambales – A second earthquake was recorded off this province on Monday morning, less than an hour after a magnitude 4.6 tremor, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). The second quake, with a magnitude 4.4, was recorded at 8:54 a.m. at a depth of 18 kilometers. Its epicenter was located at 15.51°N, 119.58°E, or about 37 kilometers north of 77° west of Palauig town in Zambales.
